note: Structured route records combine verified rule layers. They are research summaries, not legal opinions.

corridors.title: India buyer → UK auction → India
corridors.summary: An India-resident buyer bidding in the UK and importing the work into India. Key layers are outward remittance, UK export controls where applicable, and Indian import/GST classification.
unresolved: Exact auction-house premium and sale taxes
Indian customs classification and import-duty computation for the specific object

corridors.title: UAE buyer → UK auction → UAE
corridors.summary: A UAE-based buyer acquiring at a UK auction and returning the work to the UAE. Key layers are UK export controls where applicable and UAE VAT/import treatment.
unresolved: UAE customs classification/duty for the exact object and emirate entry point

corridors.title: India buyer → Singapore auction → India
corridors.summary: An India-resident buyer acquiring in Singapore and importing into India. Key layers are LRS/remittance and Indian import classification; Singapore sale-specific auction terms still need to be checked.
unresolved: Indian customs classification and import-duty computation

corridors.title: India buyer → UK auction → Singapore
corridors.summary: An India-resident buyer bidding in the UK and sending the work to Singapore. This route combines Indian remittance controls, possible UK cultural-goods export licensing and Singapore GST/import-permit treatment.
unresolved: Auction-house premium and UK sale taxes
Singapore controlled-goods check for the specific object

corridors.title: U.S. buyer → UK auction → United States
corridors.summary: A U.S.-resident buyer acquiring in the UK and importing into the United States. Many qualifying Chapter 97 categories have a Free base general duty rate, but classification and separate cultural-property or Chapter 99 measures must be checked.
unresolved: Any Chapter 99 measure affecting the item/origin
